spotify.note: previews only on grandfathered apps; audio-features/audio-analysis unavailable to apps created after 2024-11-27

bpmFolding.note: Quarter-note BPM per docs/research/musicology.md s0. Fold detector output by x2 / /2 (x3 / /3 for bar-locked vals) into the window of the catalogue rhythm; tie-break with the orchestra prior.
bpmFolding.tieBreak: nearest to orchestra_profiles.bpm[rhythm] midpoint; else keep detector top candidate with bpmConfidence=low

features.label: Tempo
features.engineUse: tanda tempo coherence (<=6% spread), physical energy term (+0.9/BPM vs pivot), pair score tempo factor; after folding, 3 x 11.9 s windows majority vote
features.caveat: medium on rubato orchestras (Pugliese, late Troilo, Di Sarli 1950s)

features.label: Local tempo spread
features.engineUse: rubato term: >4% emotional +8, >8% +14; difficulty +8/+14

features.label: Pulse clarity
features.engineUse: danceability +0.3 per point; marcato in2/in4 from energy at 2x vs 1x pulse; strongest beginner-danceability predictor

features.label: Beat attack
features.engineUse: rhythmic vs lyrical style tag; groove correlate

features.label: Key
features.engineUse: pair score key factor (weight 0.10); same-key avoidance between neighbours; never a hard rule
features.caveat: exact 60-70%, near-key 85% after tuning correction; keep second candidate

features.label: Mode
features.engineUse: valence (minor -0.15, major +0.2), emotional +5 minor, physical -3 major; mode continuity inside tango tandas

features.label: Key margin
features.engineUse: gate key factor: below 0.1 treat key as unknown (sub-score 0.7)

features.label: Reference pitch
features.engineUse: speed check vs era prior; +/-10-15 cents precision on shellac

features.label: Pitch drift inside excerpt
features.engineUse: transfer quality; Odeon-style half-semitone side drift

features.label: Loudness
features.engineUse: pair and cortina loudness match (+/-2 LU window); arousal via loudnessNorm; never energy directly; edition-specific

features.label: Loudness range
features.engineUse: lraLow<5 emotional -4; lraHigh>=9 emotional +6, difficulty +4 (lower bound from 30 s)

features.label: Crest factor
features.engineUse: brickwall detection (<8 dB) for edition ranking; dynamicsScore

features.label: True peak
features.engineUse: clipping flag for edition ranking

features.label: Brightness
features.engineUse: brightness match (semitone ramp) between neighbours and cortina->tanda; display label dark/warm/bright by corpus percentile

features.label: Bandwidth
features.engineUse: transferScore; duplicate ranking; compare within provider only

features.label: Noise floor
features.engineUse: transferScore (shellac typical ~ -30 dB SNR)

features.label: Hiss
features.engineUse: transferScore; detects fake treble boost

features.label: Clicks
features.engineUse: transferScore (impulses not on beat grid)

features.label: Onset density
features.engineUse: rhythmic (+8 physical) vs lyrical (-6 physical, +6 emotional) proxy, cross-checked with orchestra style

features.label: Onset regularity
features.engineUse: syncopation / dramatic-alternating detection; difficulty

features.label: Sustained vs percussive
features.engineUse: lyricalVsRhythmic feature in MUSICALITY

features.label: Dynamics slope
features.engineUse: excerpt is building/flat/settling; groove correlate (RMS variability r=.57)

features.label: Vocal in excerpt
features.engineUse: contradiction check against catalogue vocal flag (positive detection high, negative low because the preview may precede the estribillo)

features.label: Vocal share
features.engineUse: estribillista <0.25 / cantor de orquesta 0.25-0.55 / cantor dominant >0.55 thresholds; needs full file

features.label: Intro length
features.engineUse: position-1 cue (instrumental intro announces the tanda); needs full file

features.label: Leading silence
features.engineUse: cue-in; needs full file

features.label: Ending
features.engineUse: closer selection in shapeTanda; fades penalised; needs last 15 s of full file

features.label: Duration
features.engineUse: from provider metadata (trackTimeMillis / duration); speed check ratio vs referenceDurationSec; tanda budget

features.label: Transfer quality
features.engineUse: scorer source/transfer factor; duplicate ranking; composed from rolloff95Hz, noiseFloorDb, hissLevelDb, clickDensity, crestFactorDb, truePeakDbTP

compatibility.scope: consecutive tracks inside a tanda after hard constraints (one orchestra, one rhythm, one vocal mode, year window) are satisfied

bpmRamp.note: multiples of bpmDeltaMax[rhythm]; unknown BPM on either side -> 0.5

compatibility.keyRelationNote: Camelot steps = minimal circular distance between wheel numbers; rel = same number other letter (relative major/minor); par = same tonic other mode. Same key scores below fifth/relative on purpose (tango DJs avoid same-key neighbours for contrast; nothing is ever overlaid, so EDM harmonic mixing does not apply).
compatibility.formula: S(a,b) = 100 * sum_i w_i * s_i(a,b), each s_i in [0,1] a clamped linear ramp (1 up to fullScoreUpTo, 0 at zeroAt); badge(tanda) = round(mean(S_pairs) - 0.5 * (mean(S_pairs) - min(S_pairs))); labels: >=85 seamless, 70-84 fine, 55-69 audible step, <55 re-order or swap

energyBand.note: E_cortina - E_firstTrack; cortina ~8 points below the next tanda

loudnessBand.note: LUFS_cortina - LUFS_firstTrack; a cortina louder than the tanda is a tell

referencePitchHz.note: 435 vs 440 is 20 cents; deviations below 25 cents from the nearest plausible reference cannot be classified from audio

decision.speedSuspect: abs(cents) > centsSuspect AND sign(cents) == sign(durationRatio - 1) AND abs(durationRatio - 1) > durationRatioSuspect

knownPatterns: 1960s LP reissues ~2/3 semitone fast (Tango Music Secrets)
CTA LP transfers +2.6 Hz (~10-15 cents) on average (TangoTunes analysis)
some 1940-41 D'Arienzo sessions appear deliberately fast (~448 Hz in CTA)
Odeon 1937 cuts drop ~50 cents from start to end of side

editionRanking.dynamicsScore: 1 if crestFactorDb >= 12 and lra >= 4; 0 if crestFactorDb < 8; linear between
editionRanking.sameRecording: normTitle + orchestraId + year within 1; different takes are kept with altTake=true

mergePolicy.title: catalogue normTitle canonical; streaming titles are aliases; strip (Remastered)/(year) qualifiers
mergePolicy.duration: median of trusted editions as referenceDurationSec; streaming durations kept per edition

display.note: vocal share only with full-file analysis
